rows.label: qst620104_msg0001
rows.name: I'm home, mo!

rows.label: qst620104_msg0002
rows.name:
You idiot son! You are back already,
mo!?

rows.label: qst620104_msg0003
rows.name: Mo-mo!?

rows.label: qst620104_msg0004
rows.name: Wait, are you Meroro's son, Pulolo?

rows.label: qst620104_msg0005
rows.name: Yes, mo!!

rows.label: qst620104_msg0006
rows.name: I hate to admit it, but yes, mo...

rows.label: qst620104_msg0007
rows.name:
You left saying you would find work in
Gula, so why are you back already, mo?

rows.label: qst620104_msg0008
rows.name:
For years you just played board games,
never helping at home. I was glad you
finally stood on your own, mo.

rows.label: qst620104_msg0009
rows.name:
Mom, please listen without getting
mad, mo.

rows.label: qst620104_msg0010
rows.name: mo?

rows.label: qst620104_msg0011
rows.name:
Sadly, all the money Mom gave me to
get started is gone, mo.

rows.label: qst620104_msg0012
rows.name: Mo-mo!?

rows.label: qst620104_msg0013
rows.name:
Were you robbed, mo? And Rex saved
you...?

rows.label: qst620104_msg0014
rows.name: Right, right. Something like that, mo.

rows.label: qst620104_msg0015
rows.name: No, no...

rows.label: qst620104_msg0016
rows.name:
Actually, I spent it all on the
masterpiece game TIGER! TIGER!, mo.

rows.label: qst620104_msg0017
rows.name: Mo-mooo!?

rows.label: qst620104_msg0018
rows.name:
Sorry when you look ready to faint,
Mom, but I want another 50,000G, mo.

rows.label: qst620104_msg0019
rows.name:
This time I really will go to Gula and
find a job, mo!

rows.label: qst620104_msg0020
rows.name:
You say that, but obviously you'll
spend it all on games again, mo!

rows.label: qst620104_msg0021
rows.name:
I won't give you another cent as long
as I live, mo!

rows.label: qst620104_msg0022
rows.name:
In fact, I disown you, mo! You idiot
son!!

rows.label: qst620104_msg0023
rows.name:
I don't even want to see your face,
mo!!

rows.label: qst620104_msg0024
rows.name: Mo-mo~
軽く暗転入れて三人で相談

rows.label: qst620104_msg0103
rows.name:
What will you do now, mo? Are you
coming to Gula, mo?

rows.label: qst620104_msg0105
rows.name:
I remembered, mo! I prepared a
souvenir for times like this, mo.

rows.label: qst620104_msg0106
rows.name: The Tank Custom III!

rows.label: qst620104_msg0107
rows.name: A TIGER! TIGER! prize...

Meroro and Pulolo are talking. Tora
and Rex watch from a distance.

rows.label: qst620104_msg0201
rows.name: I got this for you, Mom, mo.

rows.label: qst620104_msg0202
rows.name: What is it, mo?

rows.label: qst620104_msg0203
rows.name:
It is called Tank Custom III. It is
very popular and valuable in Gula, mo.

rows.label: qst620104_msg0204
rows.name:
You love Salvaging finds, Mom, so I
wanted to give it to you...

rows.label: qst620104_msg0205
rows.name: Pulolo...

rows.label: qst620104_msg0206
rows.name:
What a wonderful idiot son you are,
mo!!

rows.label: qst620104_msg0207
rows.name: I'm moved, mo...!

rows.label: qst620104_msg0208
rows.name:
Pulolo is a hopeless lazy idiot who
only mooches off his parents, but he
can stay home forever, mo.

rows.label: qst620104_msg0209
rows.name: Thank you, Mom, mo!

rows.label: qst620104_msg0210
rows.name:
And they all lived happily ever after,
mo! Tora is a little moved too, mo.

rows.label: qst620104_msg0211
rows.name:
Is this really a heartwarming
story...?
